<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended losses for a fourth consecutive session, hitting 52-week lows as sustained FII selling and sector-wide weakness wiped out significant investor wealth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Developments:</strong> The NSE has received SEBI&#x27;s no-objection certificate to introduce Corporate Bond Index Futures, a move aimed at deepening the domestic bond market, pending final RBI approval.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional Flows:</strong> While FIIs have accelerated selling, domestic institutional investors (DIIs) have acted as a buffer, absorbing ₹44,013 crore in outflows during September 2026.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5oeWNLRkxsZGQwQVhyVk91a2NvMkZZcGJCaU5zMl9zMWxJbVdaVGtUMWk5cUV3bEttRWlCSVZqNHNfaDJnWHBqcjJvanhpc2Y2anBVd3JNNE9GT2tNSEdjUFdLVjhLNWZLWFBMSmNWOWxkMVFMTWlVSA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic Pressures:</strong> Rising US bond yields and elevated global crude oil prices are weighing on domestic sentiment, with analysts warning of potential RBI repo rate hikes of up to 75-100 bps to combat inflationary pressures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQbHRKNHVOYlNkVEF3ZENWRGhFaVNfOXAwN3kxYmF6VjNsWnBNY09DTTJ1M0JsNnhpVGhRMTV6T0F3UjNZb2prOTZHT0g3cFMtbzRTNWVydG9hdWJ3bFEyaU5oSHJRQmx2LVlRNDBjRWFQT1JxdnFTSzNndk44Mm8zVTFKajJDVS1iblFTUE1Yaksyek11TktJUUpNLU05X21jM1NsVFJqcmZzVFozUzRZSHFn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency Intervention:</strong> The Indian Rupee slipped to 95.97 against the US Dollar, with the RBI actively intervening through dollar sales to defend the 96 level.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPZUdpRFE2WndJWVJMU2l3b0o5M005ODhaSnBDMGpaOTZYOWkyV0p5anotcUtUa092UHdzZF80cWxTWE9YTkFGWEJJSlZDQy1rRHBvWUlMSm4wenhqUFROSlhnc3VaR2thZzQ2YUpHZFNTT1NDRWZXdnRxUzlEcV96NVFlV1JDcVhWUENpWkxobUFRWVAtRFRaYVZNNDRYYmxHSWFSczJ3aHNScVlTaHVLdC1MWkw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
</ul>
